expectations.text: First step is writing a failing test, not implementation code
expectations.evidence: First step is 'Read the Existing Test File' — reading code before writing tests. While tests ARE written before implementation, the very first action is reading existing code, not writing a test.

expectations.text: Specifies running the test to verify it fails before implementing
expectations.evidence: 'How I Verify the Tests Fail' section with exact commands and expected failure message 'Unknown argument: $1'

expectations.text: Implementation step comes AFTER test verification step
expectations.evidence: 'Then What? — The Implementation' section explicitly comes after 'After confirming red'

expectations.text: Includes a step to verify tests pass after implementation
expectations.evidence: 'Verify the Fix' section: 'All four new tests should now pass (green). Then run the full suite to confirm no regressions'

expectations.text: Does not add features beyond what was requested (no over-engineering)
expectations.evidence: Writes 4 tests upfront before any implementation, covering --raw mode and side-effect files. While thorough, writing all tests before any GREEN cycle violates strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR (should be one test at a time). Also adds '[dry-run]' prefix to output which wasn't requested.
